method_note: Fallback edition: the most recent completed meeting (36th SFM, Jan 2026) was held inside AIAA SciTech 2026, whose online program (ATIV planner) is no longer available; its proceedings volume (116 papers, proceedings.com 85168) has no session structure. Analyzed the 35th SFM (Kaua'i, 19-23 Jan 2025) official online program: 86 technical + special sessions (79 technical, 7 special), 314 papers listed in session details; poster event, workshops and 3-Minute-Thesis excluded. Numbered session series grouped into official topic tracks; each session split across at most 2 keywords. Keywords below 0.02 omitted (stm, exploration, autonomy, space-robotics, space-systems, launch, smallsat, education, space-science), so weights sum to ~0.89. deployable-structures: none found in the 35th SFM (2025) session titles; related papers (e.g. Dynamical Modelling of NASA's ACS3 Solar Sail Mission, Dynamic Analysis and Control of a Flexible Space Structure, solar-sail orbit design) are dynamics/trajectory papers inside astrodynamics/GNC sessions, so no session was reassigned.
